name: Department of Management Studies, National Institute of Technology (NIT) Silchar

cutoffs.note: Eligibility floor for applying: CAT 2025 (or MAT/CMAT Sept 2025-March 2026) with minimum 50 percentile. Same floor stated for all categories (no category split given). Selection weights: CAT/CMAT/MAT percentile 50, GD/WAT/PI 30, academics 20.

source.title: NIT Silchar DoMS - Admission Notification and Information Brochure, MBA Programme 2026-28

cutoffs.quote: A candidate must have appeared in CAT (in the year 2025) or MAT/CMAT (the tests taken between Sept 2025 to March 2026) with a minimum 50 percentile score is eligible to apply with a valid score card.

statusNote: Official 2026-28 MBA brochure from the NIT Silchar DoMS notice board. 2027-29 notification not yet published as of 2026-11-12.
